Structured chapters/physics-12-9/06_simplify/chapter.simplified.hi.md into 07_format/structured.hi.md per step_7/PROMPT.md. Since mdio.markdown_to_chapter() cannot parse nested containers (per CLAUDE.md point 3), this stage hand-authored the nested markup directly as text: parsed the flat file with tag._parse(), then for every :::solution node (item-level and part-level, 66 total across the chapter's 39 items) replaced its flat text with nested :::concept{label=जानकारी}/:::step{label=मान रखो}/:::step{label=निष्कर्ष} blocks via a depth-aware sentence-segmentation heuristic (splits on the Devanagari purna viram, never inside a $...$/$$...$$ math span or inside parentheses -- a real bug hit and fixed during development: an early version split a parenthetical aside containing its own purna viram, e.g. q_9.19, stranding a bare ')' as its own 'conclusion' block; fixed by tracking paren depth alongside dollar depth). A leading 'दिया है'/'माना'/'यहाँ' clause becomes the given concept only when short and followed by more content; a trailing sentence matching 'अतः'/'अत:'/'इसलिए'/'अर्थात्' (or a short non-derivation closing line) becomes the concluding step; everything else in between is one 'मान रखो' step -- not every solution gets all stages (many short ones are a single step, or concept+conclusion with no separate substitute step), per the 'not every solution has all four' rule. No :::formula/:::table/:::note/:::concept-standalone blocks were added: this chapter has no standalone tables or textbook remarks separate from each worked solution's own flow, and no free-standing definitions -- wrapping key equations in a separate :::formula tier was skipped in favour of leaving them inline within the 'मान रखो' step (labelling is a convention, not a schema requirement). All 6 figures stay at item level (already positioned before parts/solution by render_item(), matching where each is actually referenced -- none of this chapter's figures are referenced mid-solution). No question text, figure caption, or answer field touched -- only :::solution content was restructured. Gates: tag._parse succeeds on the full output (every container balances, every name in the fixed vocabulary -- verified programmatically, zero violations) and protect.parity(stage6, stage7) shows zero drift in display-math/inline-math/table/image counts (nothing eaten by the restructuring).

Serialized 07_format/structured.hi.md's container tree into 08_tag/structured.hi.json per step_8/PROMPT.md. Every text-bearing field (prompt/answer/a block's flow) is an ordered list of {type:'text'|'figure', ...} segments, never a flat string. Explicit :::concept blocks always stage=given, explicit :::formula always stage=key_formula (none of this chapter's items used a separate :::formula tier -- key equations stayed inline within the 'मान रखो' step per stage 7's notes, so key_formula count is 0, which is expected, not a bug). A :::step already labelled मान रखो/निष्कर्ष from stage 7 keeps that stage (substitute/conclusion) as-is, not re-derived. Any :::step stage 7 left unlabelled (or a bare flat solution stage 7 never split at all) had its stage inferred by position among that SAME solution's own stageable blocks (first=given, last=conclusion, middle=substitute, a lone block=conclusion), done independently per part for every multi-part item, never against the item's other parts. No 'हल'/'हल:'/'हल :' opener text needed stripping (the label was already an attribute on the :::solution container from stage 7's render, never embedded as literal flow text in this chapter's data). No :::note blocks exist in this chapter (no textbook remarks separate from each solution's own flow). Two items (ex_9.3, ex_9.4) have BOTH non-empty parts AND genuine item-level solution_blocks -- this is NOT the 'known duplicate-solution artifact' the prompt warns about (a re-narrated whole-item solution with degraded numbers that should be suppressed): it's real shared setup content each part's own working depends on (e.g. ex_9.3's item-level 'फोकस दूरी f=-7.5cm', which both part (i) and (ii) reference via 'समीकरण (9.7) से') -- kept as item-level solution_blocks (stage given), not dropped. Figure src kept in 'images/fig_...' form throughout, never stripped to a bare filename (verified via the gate below, which checks src strings directly). Gate: re-parsed a FRESH, independent count from structured.hi.md (not the in-memory tally used while building the JSON) for item count, part count, and distinct figure src count (both :::figure containers and any stray inline ![]() image ref) -- all three match the JSON exactly, zero drops/duplicates.

Exported 09_design/final.hi.html to 10_pdf/final.hi.pdf with Playwright/Chromium per step_10/PROMPT.md: navigated to the file's own file:// path (not a copy), waited on document.fonts.ready before printing, called page.emulate_media(media='screen') immediately before page.pdf() (the standing per-export fix for Chromium's print-media Devanagari pre-base-vowel text-shaping bug -- applied unconditionally, not only when a title/heading visibly needs it), and used print_background=True + prefer_css_page_size=True (never an explicit format/width/height) so the @page/A4/9mm-margin rules already in final.hi.css govern pagination rather than Playwright's own default page size. Gate results: page count 22 (sane for a 39-item, 8-example + 31-exercise chapter -- this chapter's own page count is expected to be the largest of any chapter built so far, given it is the largest/most figure-dense chapter extracted at stage 1); zero blank pages; the numeric read-back re-run directly against the PDF's OWN extracted text (via PyMuPDF/fitz, not assumed carried over from stage 9's HTML-based check) for all 240 numeric tokens across every question/final_answer field in 06_simplify/chapter.simplified.hi.md -- 0 missing. Applied the documented superscript-exponent trap fix: unicode superscript digits are normalized back to ASCII with a '^' separator inserted before each new run of superscript characters, so a base number and its exponent (e.g. this chapter's own 10^6/10^8 orbital-radius figures in q_9.14) normalize to two distinct tokens rather than gluing into one merged digit string that would hide a genuine number from ever matching (this chapter's own content doesn't happen to have a base+exponent combination whose glued form would coincidentally still 'find' a wrong number, but the fix is applied unconditionally per the standing rule, not diagnosed per chapter). This is a purely mechanical stage -- no model judgment, per Rule 2 and step_10/PROMPT.md; the known, unresolved Chromium reph-character (र्) ToUnicode CMap extraction bug documented in step_10/PROMPT.md is orthogonal to this gate (it only affects copy/search of 'र्'+consonant sequences, not the digit-only numeric read-back) and is flagged here for the record, not fixed (no known fix exists from within this pipeline).
